questions.question: Describe the structure, functions, and powers of the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI). / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the structure, functions, and powers of the Food Safety and Standards
  • Authority of India (FSSAI).[U] / [CO3]The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
  • (FSSAI) is a statutory body responsible for regulating food safety and standards in India. It
  • operates under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
  • Structure:
  • • Establishment: FSSAI was established in 2006 under the Food Safety and Standards Act,
  • 2006.
  • • Headquarters: Located in New Delhi.
  • • Leadership: Led by a Chairperson, appointed by the central government, along with a
  • team of members from various fields, including food science, public health, and law.
  • • Regional Offices: FSSAI has several regional offices across India to facilitate its
  • operations.
  • Functions:
  • • Regulation, Enforcement, Standards Setting
  • FSSAI plays a crucial role in ensuring the safety and quality of food in India, thereby
  • protecting public health.
